testcase.name: Scenario: Keep a pinned constraint expansion across sketch edit: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:716:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep a pinned constraint expansion across sketch edit ✔ Given the MCAD Software has an active part containing an existing sketch ✔ And the full Sketch ribbon is visible outside sketch edit ✔ When the user opens the Constrain panel additional area ✔ Then Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are unavailable ✔ When the user clicks the unavailable Edit Coordinate System command ✔ Then the additional area remains open and no command starts ✔ When the user pins the additional area ✔ And the user opens the existing sketch for editing ✔ Then the Constrain additional area remains open and pinned ✔ And Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are available ✔ When the user finishes the sketch without editing it ✔ Then the Constrain additional area remains open and pinned ✔ And Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are unavailable
